gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai reads in solid blocks, not jagged skylines. Grandstander up top draws its bold lines with one fixed pen, while the body's curves keep generous gaps at the stems, so a long page of text flows easily.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps its throats open and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase around them. Grandstander brings the sign-shop vinyl punch.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho hits the eye like thick chalk pressed hard, with a wide gap at the end of each e. Grandstander shouts; Wancho holds the line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-warang-: Grandstander's lines are cut at a single depth, like an engraver's. Noto Sans Warang Citi lets words settle into solid blocks, and its wide channels into each counter mean you can size it modestly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-yi: Chunky, round, and unsealed. Grandstander's bowls keep their walls constant all the way round, and Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep midsection and hooks that never quite latch, which keeps long paragraphs moving.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-zanabaz: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with a tall x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, set under a heading that looks like a single-weight outline. Its openness is the pair's strongest card.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-traditional-: Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, its bowls filling the line. And Grandstander, with no pinching at its curves, makes a text that feels friendly page after page.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-numans: Loud, round, and playful up top. Grandstander is built to grab attention, while Numans spreads its swollen lowercase out with generous tracking and an s whose ends hang far from the spine, made for steady reading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-onest: Onest keeps short ascenders above big bowls and a gentle monotone line. Grandstander handles the bold, expressive shouting, whereas Onest quietly carries the explaining without ink pooling at any turn.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-orienta: Modern, with a skeleton outline given one fixed stroke thickness up top. Grandstander does the loud, expressive work best, while Orienta's breathing counters and small case-to-case height difference carry the quiet lines.
